einzeiler: Overview of the upcoming THRIVE events in Rexburg, San Antonio, Boise, and St. George
kurzfassung: Announcing four upcoming THRIVE conferences aimed at former and transitioning members of high-demand religions. The events focus on community building, healing, and navigating a faith crisis after Mormonism. Each event features specific speakers, panels, and presentations covering various aspects of life after high-demand religion.
stichpunkte: THRIVE Rexburg scheduled for September 18–19, 2026, featuring keynote speaker Britt Hartley alongside Renae Peterson, Erika Nordfelt, and Nan Osborne.
THRIVE San Antonio scheduled for September 26, 2026, with speakers Alyssa Grenfell, Nathan Hinckley, Megan Conner, Elbert Fish, and Meggan Hayes.
THRIVE Boise scheduled for October 4, 2026, featuring keynote speaker Dr. John G. Turner, Amy Faragher, Kolby Reddish, and Andrew Propst.

THRIVE St. George scheduled for March 5–7, 2027, featuring Michael Foley, Chris Bartlett, Sally and Lena Osborne, Kolby Reddish, Dr. Christine Marie, Nomz Bistline, Dr. John Lundwall, and Dr. Julie de Azevedo.
